content_sections.heading: CSIR CGCRI Project Assistant - II at a Glance

rows.details: Developing Patentable Fabrication Process for HFCL Proprietary Product i.e. Silica Based Nested Antiresonant Nodeless Fiber for Next Generation Optical Communication Networks
Initially for 1 Year and extendable up to 29.01.2028 based on the availability of fund
Rs. 20,000/- + HRA (Increment of 15% for 3 years of experience in the same project)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: B.Sc.(Physics) or 3 years Diploma in Engineering / Technology in Electronics or Mechanical or Electrical with minimum 60% marks/GPA. Desirable Qualifications: Experience in electronics or machine handling, glass handling, electrical. Proficient in basic computer skills, CAD software. Lab skills in optics/fiber optics/optomechanics. Age Limit and Relaxation: The upper age limit is 35 years. The upper age limit is relaxable by up to 5 years in case of candidates belonging to SC/ST/Physically Handicapped and Female, whereas 3 years in case of OBCs (Non-Creamy layer candidates).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a stipend of Rs. 20,000/- per month plus HRA, with an increment of 15% for every 3 years of experience in the same project. The initial tenure is for 1 year and is extendable up to 29 January 2028 subject to fund availability.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR CGCRI Project Assistant - II
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website at www.cgcri.res.in. Fill out the application form strictly in a typed format (hand-written applications are not accepted). Enclose soft copies of self-attested copies of all supporting documents, certificates, and reprints. Send the soft copy of the filled application form and attachments via email to [email protected] on or before 1 November 2026. Bring all original mark sheets, certificates, age-proof, and self-attested copies of documents at the time of the interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be called for a Walk-in-Interview to be held on 03/11/2026 from 2.30 p.m. at CSIR-CGCRI, Kolkata. Candidates must report at least one hour before the scheduled time for document verification. No candidate will be allowed to enter the institute after reporting time.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Project Assistant - II post permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The position is temporary and tenable at CSIR-CGCRI, Kolkata, initially for 1 year and extendable up to 29 January 2028 based on fund availability.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA and increments included with the stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, the stipend is Rs. 20,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA). An increment of 15% is provided for 3 years of experience in the same project.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is relaxable by up to 5 years for SC, ST, Physically Handicapped, and Female candidates, and by 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy layer) candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application deadline and mode of submission?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent via email in soft copy format to [email protected] by 1 November 2026.
